title: Stonewake Sanctuary
subtitle: The Seal of Stone
intro: Stonewake was built by the first Wardens to teach patience.
Orrin the Unmoving kept the Stone Seal here. The shadows have buried him alive.
Make a fist and the earth will answer. Stand your ground, Warden.
outro: The stone remembers your resolve. Somewhere beneath the rubble, Orrin exhales.
Water calls from the drowned ruins to the east.

boss_lines.intro: Orrin's guardian wakes, twisted by the Rift: STAY... DOWN...
boss_lines.phase2: Cracks race across its body, and the ground answers with falling stone.
boss_lines.phase3: Its eyes burn red. It will crush anything that stands still!
boss_lines.defeat: The Stone Guardian crumbles. The Seal of Stone hums back to life.

lore: Stonewake was raised in a single night by the first Wardens, who believed that patience was the first element.
Its Seal binds the earth. What is rooted cannot be unmade, and what is unmade can be rooted again.

title: Tidelost Ruins
subtitle: The Seal of Tide
intro: The Tidelost Ruins drown beneath a sky of falling embers.
Sael's bell has not rung since the Rift, and the water has learned to hold grudges.
Water does not fight the stone; it flows around it. Flow around danger, Warden.
outro: The bell rings once, clear and low. The tide remembers its shape.
Above the clouds, the Skyglass Spires flicker like a signal fire.

boss_lines.intro: The Drowned Bell tolls, and something vast surfaces beneath it.
boss_lines.phase2: The water around it turns black. Watch for the surge!
boss_lines.phase3: It sheds its shell. What is left moves like a flood.
boss_lines.defeat: The Tide Guardian dissolves into rain. The bell rings on.

lore: The ruins were a harbor city. Its people left the bell behind so that the sea would always know where home was.
The Tide Seal binds water, and water carries every message the world has ever sent.

title: Skyglass Spires
subtitle: The Seal of Gale
intro: The Skyglass Spires are broken towers of glass that sing in the wind.
Ysa Windreader read the sky for a hundred years. Now the sky is reading her.
Air gives way to nothing and yields to everything. Move lightly, Warden.
outro: The storm clears. For the first time in a month, a star is visible.
Far below, the Cinderforge burns hotter than any forge should.

boss_lines.intro: The wind goes silent, which is worse than any storm.
boss_lines.phase2: Walls of wind close in. Find the gap!
boss_lines.phase3: The silence breaks. Everything it has is coming at once.
boss_lines.defeat: The Gale Guardian unravels into a clear sky.

lore: Ysa taught that the wind has no enemies, only obstacles it has not met yet.
The Gale Seal binds air. Wherever it is whole, no storm can hold a grudge for long.

title: Cinderforge
subtitle: The Seal of Ember
intro: The Cinderforge never cooled. Kael Emberhand made the Wardens' first blades here.
The Ember Seal is chained to the forge-heart, and the dark is trying to melt the chains.
Fire is purpose made visible. Strike before the dark can blink away.
outro: Four seals burn as one. The Loom of Dawn shudders and begins to turn.
The Eclipse Citadel is exposed at last.

boss_lines.intro: The forge-heart opens like an eye.
boss_lines.phase2: Molten rain begins to fall. Keep moving!
boss_lines.phase3: It is burning its own seal to keep you out.
boss_lines.defeat: The Ember Guardian goes dark. The forge-heart beats steadily again.

lore: Kael believed that a blade was only a promise somebody had hammered flat.
The Ember Seal binds fire. Fire does not destroy, it transforms, and the Rift is afraid of that.

title: Eclipse Citadel
subtitle: The Rift
intro: Every restored seal points to the same wound in the world.
At its center waits the Rift Sovereign: Veyra, the Warden who taught you everything.
She tried to hold all five elements alone. The Rift was the price.
Master Lightning. Enter Convergence. Bring her home.
outro: Veyra kneels, and the Rift closes around her like a held breath.
Dawn reaches every corner of the realm. The seals are whole.

boss_lines.intro: 'I held all five alone, little Warden. Show me you can do better.'
boss_lines.phase2: 'You have two hands. I only ever trusted one.'
boss_lines.phase3: 'Then show me the Convergence. Show me what I missed.'
boss_lines.defeat: 'Two hands... not one. I should have taught you that first.'

lore: Veyra was the strongest Warden of her age. She believed that a single will could carry all five elements.
She was wrong, but she was brave, and the Rift remembers her as both.
